title: people-ops recruiting coordinator daily scratchpad 2026-03-12
content:
Daily scratchpad - quick wins + TODOs (Taylor)
Date: 2026-03-12

Top priorities (must finish today)
- Confirm panel availability for Backend Eng (ref: JIRA-4821) — need final confirmation from Eng hiring manager by 11:00am PT.
- Send offer follow-up email to candidate Maya R. (waiting on sign-off from recruiter). Template below.
- Close loop on DST timezone confusion for EMEA interviews (update calendar tz and invite notes).

Candidate follow-ups (quick status)
- Maya R. (SWE-2) — verbal offer sent 3/11, asked for 24h to review. Action: send nudge + high-level comp summary by 2pm if no response.
- Diego M. (SWE-IC) — interview scheduled 3/15 10am PT, but candidate indicated conflict; reached out to reschedule, awaiting times. Action: propose 3 slots (3/16 9am, 3/17 11am, 3/18 2pm).
- Priya K. (PM) — feedback from panel in 3 docs: two thumbs up, one concern re: product sense. Ask hiring manager for final decision.

Scheduling reminders / calendar housekeeping
- Block off 12:30-1:30 for interview packet prep (do before 12:30).
- Check that all interview invites include transit/parking instructions for SF office. Add link to office visitor policy.
- Update candidate timezone notes: always add "TZ: America/Los_Angeles (PT)" or "TZ: Europe/London (GMT)" in invite title to avoid confusion.

Quick message templates (use and personalize)
- Nudge for offer: 
  Hi Maya — quick check-in to see if you had any questions about the offer we sent yesterday. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful. No rush, just wanted to make sure you received it. — Taylor

- Reschedule request: 
  Hi Diego — thanks for flagging the conflict. Would any of these times work instead? 1) Tue 3/16 9:00am PT 2) Wed 3/17 11:00am PT 3) Thu 3/18 2:00pm PT. If none, tell me a couple windows that do. — Taylor

Interview logistics checklist (for each candidate)
- Confirm panelers have read resume + prompt deck (send reminder 24h before).
- Confirm Zoom link set, recording permission on, notetakers assigned (usually Samir).
- Confirm candidate has access instructions & recruiter contact number.
- Add debrief form link to calendar invite.

Notes to self / open questions
- Revisit interview debrief rubric: is product sense weighting clear? Slack PM team for alignment.
- Follow up w/ finance on equity comps bracket for senior hires (email sent 3/9, no reply).
- Create canned reply for weekend availability requests (small template).

Misc quick items
- Approve time-off for caller on 3/19 (done).
- Remove stale reqs from Greenhouse (two reqs with no activity >90 days).

End-of-day wrap (what I need to have done before logging off)
- Offer nudge to Maya sent or recorded follow-up planned.
- Panel confirmations for Backend Eng done or escalated.
- Reschedule options proposed to Diego.
- Updated calendar invites with TZ and office instructions.

----
Raw notes / fragments (untidy)
- Interview packet: include one-pager w/ role scope + rubric + sample question bank.
- Escalate if no panel confirmations by noon -> ping EM + cc head of eng.
- Reminder: check travel approval policy for candidates requiring in-person interview travel (budget cap?).
summary: Daily people-ops recruiting coordinator to-do list: follow-ups, scheduling, templates, and interview logistics.
